newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian March tax collection to miss mark 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Russian March tax collection to miss mark 15 pct.

text.p: Russian tax revenues in March will not reach targeted levels, the State Tax Inspectorate said on Thursday.
It said collections over from March 1-25 were only 79 percent of targeted levels. Total March tax revenues would be only 21.9 trillion roubles, or 85 percent of the monthly target.
But it said the amount collected over March 1-25, or 17.6 trillion roubles, was more than double the amount collected over a similar period in February.
Total February tax payments to the federal budget were 13.9 trillion roubles.
Poor tax collection is one of the acutest economic problems in Russia and has prompted the International Monetary Fund to suspend payment of some of tranches of its $10 billion loan.
Some loans were later disbursed, but January and February tranches have not yet been approved, in part due to low budget revenues.
